title: PHQ-9 Patient Health Questionnaire
description: A 9-item depression assessment tool for initial diagnosis and tracking of depressive symptom severity.

introductions.scoring_rule: Assign scores of 0, 1, 2, and 3 to the responses: 'Not at all', 'Several days', 'More than half the days', 'Nearly every day'. Total score ranges from 0 to 27.

diagnosis_criteria.major_depression: At least 5 items scored 2 or 3, including #1 or #2
diagnosis_criteria.other_depression: 2 to 4 items scored 2 or 3, including #1 or #2

introductions.monitoring_guidelines: Patients may complete the PHQ-9 at baseline and at regular intervals (e.g., every 2 weeks). Use the same scoring system to track symptom changes.

questions: 1. Little interest or pleasure in doing things
3. Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much
4. Feeling tired or having little energy
6. Feeling bad about yourself, or that you are a failure or let your family down
7. Trouble concentrating on things (e.g., reading, watching TV)
8. Moving or speaking slowly / being fidgety or restless more than usual
9. Thoughts of being better off dead, or hurting yourself

additional_questions.question: If you checked any problems, how difficult have they made it for you to do your work, take care of things at home, or get along with other people?
